title: Scene and 360 player: Escape, A and Tab do nothing there
description: Fabio 2026-10-21: in the 3D Scene and the 360 video player the app's hotkeys are dead. Escape never returns to the gallery (neither Block binds it), A (Agent mode) is gated off the whole Scene page so the 360 player loses it although nothing flies there, and the Tab radial is gated to gallery/group-history only. Scene keeps Q and A as fly keys.
